compressed_rules.name: FIRST_BUYABLE_OPEN_ANCHOR
compressed_rules.definition: Within market sessions signal_cal_idx+1 through signal_cal_idx+3, take the first PIT-valid, lineage-valid, legally tradable open strictly below the contemporaneous upper limit. Freeze its corporate-action coordinate open as the price-discovery anchor. If none exists, do not trade.

compressed_rules.name: FIVE_TRADED_SESSION_RELATIVE_ACCEPTANCE
compressed_rules.definition: Count the anchor session as observation session 1 and use the first five PIT-valid traded sessions with unchanged coordinate lineage. At session 5 close require coord_close >= anchor_coord_open and stock return anchor_coord_open-to-observation_coord_close strictly greater than the contemporaneous broad-market median return over the identical anchor-date open to observation-date close interval. All market constituents must be valid at both endpoints and retain unchanged coordinate lineage.

compressed_rules.name: NEXT_LEGAL_OPEN_ENTRY
compressed_rules.definition: After the observation-session-5 close, enter only at the first PIT-valid, lineage-valid, legally tradable non-limit-up open in observation_cal_idx+1 through observation_cal_idx+3. No same-bar fill and no later chase.

compressed_rules.name: CONFIRMED_ANCHOR_FAILURE_OR_H20_EXIT
compressed_rules.definition: After entry, retain the frozen 20-market-session lifecycle. If two consecutive PIT-valid traded closes are below the frozen anchor, schedule an exit for the next PIT-valid, lineage-valid, legally tradable non-limit-down open. Otherwise exit at the first such open on or after entry_cal_idx+20. The earlier executable action wins. T+1, suspensions, limits, corporate actions, and fail-closed lineage remain binding.

market_state_semantics.causal_market_handling: The admission rule compares stock and broad-market return over the same already-completed observation interval; no future market state is used.

development_gate.if_pass: Freeze unchanged and evaluate signal years 2022-2024.
development_gate.if_fail: Close this exact family without parameter, threshold, horizon, or market-regime rescue and move to a genuinely different economic mother family.

forbidden_rescues: late entry after the three-session window
